dialogues.jp: 今日から、俺はあの家に独りぼっちだ。
dialogues.en: Today was the first day I would sleep in this house alone.
dialogues.text: Today was the first day I would sleep in this house alone.

dialogues.jp:
夢に向かって旅立つ音夢を見送った夕暮れは、
どことなく、俺の郷愁を誘った。
dialogues.en:
I sent off Nemu, chasing her own dreams, in the evening.
Nostalgia invited me soon after.
dialogues.text:
I sent off Nemu, chasing her own dreams, in the evening.
Nostalgia invited me soon after.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が初めてウチへ来てから今までのことが、
フラッシュバックする。
dialogues.en: Remembering the day where Nemu first entered this house.
dialogues.text: Remembering the day where Nemu first entered this house.

dialogues.jp:
懐かしさと寂しさやいろんなことが、一緒くた
になって、俺の胸の中をぐるぐると回る。
dialogues.en:
Remembering how much we used to be together, now that we
weren't, made my chest tighten up.
dialogues.text:
Remembering how much we used to be together, now that we
weren't, made my chest tighten up.

dialogues.jp: ──と、あまり寂しがってても仕方がない。
dialogues.en: --But, I'd have to learn to deal with this loneliness.
dialogues.text: --But, I'd have to learn to deal with this loneliness.

dialogues.jp: 音夢がいなくなった。
dialogues.en: Nemu won't be here anymore.
dialogues.text: Nemu won't be here anymore.

dialogues.jp:
つ・ま・り、あの家の帝王は俺だ！　文句を言
うものは誰もなく、いつ寝て、いつ起きようが、
いつ何を食べても、まったく問題ないのだ。
dialogues.en:
In other words, I'm the ruler of this house now! No one can
question or complain about when I sleep, when I wake up, or
when I eat.
dialogues.text:
In other words, I'm the ruler of this house now! No one can
question or complain about when I sleep, when I wake up, or
when I eat.

dialogues.jp:
気が付くと、辺りは暗くなっていた。夕方だか
らというのもあるが、どうやら頭上には、薄暗
い雲が低く広がっていた。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, the area around turned dark. Even though it was
evening, there were several dark clouds obstructing the sun.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, the area around turned dark. Even though it was
evening, there were several dark clouds obstructing the sun.

dialogues.jp: 「早く帰らないと、マズイな……」
dialogues.en: "If I don't hurry home, I'd be caught in this..."
dialogues.text: "If I don't hurry home, I'd be caught in this..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、帰り道のベッキーズで、ハンバーガーセッ
トを買い、家路を急いだ。
dialogues.en:
Stopping by a local fast-food outlet on the way to order a
hamburger set, I hurriedly made my way home.
dialogues.text:
Stopping by a local fast-food outlet on the way to order a
hamburger set, I hurriedly made my way home.

dialogues.jp: テレビを見てると、時々空が鳴るのが聞こえた。
dialogues.en:
While watching TV, the sound of thunder constantly roared
through the sky.
dialogues.text:
While watching TV, the sound of thunder constantly roared
through the sky.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ポテトをかじりながら、ニュース番組に
切り替える。
dialogues.en:
Munching on some potato chips, I switched the TV to the news
channel.
dialogues.text:
Munching on some potato chips, I switched the TV to the news
channel.

dialogues.jp:
狙い通り、ちょうど天気予報をやっていて、初
音島辺りの地図が映し出されていた。
dialogues.en:
Just in time, the programme was the weather forecast. An
entire map of hatsunejima, all covered with grey clouds, was
being shown.
dialogues.text:
Just in time, the programme was the weather forecast. An
entire map of hatsunejima, all covered with grey clouds, was
being shown.

dialogues.speaker: Newcaster
dialogues.jp:
「──南部では、夜半過ぎに雨模様となり、と
　ころによっては強い風を伴う天気となるでしょ
　う」
dialogues.en:
"--The southern part of the island will see heavy rains past
midnight, coupled with strong winds."
dialogues.text:
"--The southern part of the island will see heavy rains past
midnight, coupled with strong winds."

dialogues.jp:
テレビに映っているお姉さんは、明るい笑顔で
暗くなる天気の話をしていた。
dialogues.en:
The onee-san-like newscaster on the TV delivered the news of
gloomy weather with a bright smile.
dialogues.text:
The onee-san-like newscaster on the TV delivered the news of
gloomy weather with a bright smile.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、降るか……」
dialogues.en: "It's going to rain, and hard..."
dialogues.text: "It's going to rain, and hard..."

dialogues.jp:
窓から見える雲は、すごい勢いで東の方へ向かっ
て流れていた。
dialogues.en:
Looking out the window, I could see several black clouds
pouring in from the east.
dialogues.text:
Looking out the window, I could see several black clouds
pouring in from the east.

dialogues.jp:
別に雨が嫌いというわけではないけれど、あま
り気持ちのいいものではない。
dialogues.en:
It's not that I particularly dislike rain, but I was getting
a bad feeling from this.
dialogues.text:
It's not that I particularly dislike rain, but I was getting
a bad feeling from this.

dialogues.jp: 特に、ひとりになってしまったこんな夜は。
dialogues.en: What a day to spend alone for the first time.
dialogues.text: What a day to spend alone for the first time.

dialogues.jp:
なにせ、テレビを消すと、家全体がシーンとし
てしまうのだ。
dialogues.en:
I switched off the TV, and went to check out how the house
was doing.
dialogues.text:
I switched off the TV, and went to check out how the house
was doing.

dialogues.jp:
俺の通る道にしか明かりがない状況というのは、
『俺帝国の誕生だ！』なんて言ってる場合では
ない。
dialogues.en:
This is no time to be celebrating the birth of the new
emperor of this castle.
dialogues.text:
This is no time to be celebrating the birth of the new
emperor of this castle.

dialogues.jp: ──ざざん
dialogues.en: --*whoooosh*
dialogues.text: --*whoooosh*

dialogues.jp:
突然、窓がガタガタと震え、庭の木がバサバサ
と大きな音を立てて揺れる。
dialogues.en:
A strong wind suddenly blew past, making the windows
shudder, and the branches of the tree outside shake.
dialogues.text:
A strong wind suddenly blew past, making the windows
shudder, and the branches of the tree outside shake.

dialogues.jp: 「イヤな風が出てきたなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "This wind doesn't feel good..."
dialogues.text: "This wind doesn't feel good..."

dialogues.jp:
暗闇の中で、木の枝が揺れる様は、何かが出て
きそうな気がする。
dialogues.en:
In the darkness, the tree's branches were swaying back and
forth. I couldn't shake the feeling that something big was
happening.
dialogues.text:
In the darkness, the tree's branches were swaying back and
forth. I couldn't shake the feeling that something big was
happening.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、思わずブルルと肩を震わせた。
dialogues.en: My shoulders started to shiver by themselves.
dialogues.text: My shoulders started to shiver by themselves.

dialogues.jp:
テレビのチャンネルをバラエティ系に戻し、不
気味な風のことは忘れることにする。
dialogues.en:
I tried to take my mind off the wind, by switching the TV
back on, and watching a variety program.
dialogues.text:
I tried to take my mind off the wind, by switching the TV
back on, and watching a variety program.

dialogues.jp: ──ざざん、ざざん
dialogues.en: --*whoooosh*
dialogues.text: --*whoooosh*

dialogues.jp:
強い風に、庭に生えている花壇の草が抜けてし
まいそうなほどに斜めになっている。
dialogues.en:
The wind outside was so strong, it was uprooting some of the
flowers in the garden.
dialogues.text:
The wind outside was so strong, it was uprooting some of the
flowers in the garden.

dialogues.jp: 「……まさか、なぁ」
dialogues.en: "...Just maybe, that..."
dialogues.text: "...Just maybe, that..."

dialogues.jp:
俺の｛のうり／脳裡｝に、暴風にさらされている弱々しい草
の姿がよぎった。
dialogues.en: My mind wandered to a certain weak-looking plant.
dialogues.text: My mind wandered to a certain weak-looking plant.

dialogues.jp: 「こんな、強い雨の降りそうな時に……」
dialogues.en: "During this strong rain, it might..."
dialogues.text: "During this strong rain, it might..."

dialogues.jp:
いや、こんな強い雨の降りそうな夜だからこそ、
そのまさかがあり得るのだ。
dialogues.en:
No, in this strong rain and wind at night, that "maybe" is a
definite possibility.
dialogues.text:
No, in this strong rain and wind at night, that "maybe" is a
definite possibility.

dialogues.jp:
「……いなかったら、帰ってくればいいだけか。
　ったく、かったるい」
dialogues.en: "...If it's gone, I'd just head back. Bah, how troublesome."
dialogues.text: "...If it's gone, I'd just head back. Bah, how troublesome."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、舌打ちをしながら、冷めてまずくなった
ポテトを口の中に押し込んだ。
dialogues.en:
Smacking my lips, I threw the last of the potato chips down
my throat.
dialogues.text:
Smacking my lips, I threw the last of the potato chips down
my throat.

dialogues.jp: ったく、自分の方が風に飛ばされそうなクセに。
dialogues.en:
Sheesh, if I'm going to let myself be thrown around by those
winds,
dialogues.text:
Sheesh, if I'm going to let myself be thrown around by those
winds,

dialogues.jp:
どのみち雨は降ってくるだろう。俺は、折りた
たみ傘を手に持って、外に出る。
dialogues.en:
I better bring an umbrella. I quickly grabbed one and headed
outside.
dialogues.text:
I better bring an umbrella. I quickly grabbed one and headed
outside.

dialogues.jp:
ドアの向こうでは、風がビュウビュウとうなり
声をあげていた。
dialogues.en:
Past the door to outside, the wind started blowing even
stronger, emitting a voice that was practically calling out
to me.
dialogues.text:
Past the door to outside, the wind started blowing even
stronger, emitting a voice that was practically calling out
to me.

dialogues.jp:
俺は『かったるい』と言いながら、玄関のノブ
に手をかけた。
dialogues.en:
With yet another "troublesome", I turned the knob to the
door.
dialogues.text:
With yet another "troublesome", I turned the knob to the
door.

dialogues.jp: 「ヤな天気だよ、まったく……」
dialogues.en: "Man, what horrible weather..."
dialogues.text: "Man, what horrible weather..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、いつもより速いペースで学校に向かう。
dialogues.en:
With a far faster pace than uual, I headed towards the
school.
dialogues.text:
With a far faster pace than uual, I headed towards the
school.

dialogues.jp:
風は強く、まるで足が絡め取られるように重く
感じた。
dialogues.en: The strong wind seemed to make each step heavier than usual.
dialogues.text: The strong wind seemed to make each step heavier than usual.

dialogues.jp:
それでも俺は、早く学校に着きたい一心で前に
進んだ。
dialogues.en:
But, with the thought of making it to school as fast as
possible on my mind, I amde steady progress through the
wind.
dialogues.text:
But, with the thought of making it to school as fast as
possible on my mind, I amde steady progress through the
wind.

dialogues.jp:
校門が見えた頃、ぽつ、ぽつと、頬に固い水の
粒が当たった。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I could see the school, drops of rain started
hitting my cheeks.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I could see the school, drops of rain started
hitting my cheeks.

dialogues.jp: （……とうとう降り出したか）
dialogues.en: "(...It's starting to rain.)"
dialogues.text: "(...It's starting to rain.)"

dialogues.jp: 俺はさらに足を速める。
dialogues.en: I quicked my pace further.
dialogues.text: I quicked my pace further.

dialogues.en: "--Tsukishiro!"
dialogues.text: "--Tsukishiro!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai?"
dialogues.text: "...Senpai?"

dialogues.jp:
予想通り、強い風に煽られながら、ロスキルラ
ベンダーに付き添う月城がいた。
dialogues.en:
Just as I foresaw, Tsukishiro was trying to protect the
Roskill Lavender from the violent winds.
dialogues.text:
Just as I foresaw, Tsukishiro was trying to protect the
Roskill Lavender from the violent winds.

dialogues.jp:
「なにしてるんだよ！　こんなに風が吹いてる
　のに！」
dialogues.en:
"What are you doing! The wind'll just blow you away at this
rate!"
dialogues.text:
"What are you doing! The wind'll just blow you away at this
rate!"

dialogues.jp: 髪の毛がバサバサと風に煽られる。
dialogues.en: I swept the rain off my hair.
dialogues.text: I swept the rain off my hair.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩は」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, why..."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, why..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「俺は、月城のことが心配になって」
dialogues.en: "I was worried about you!"
dialogues.text: "I was worried about you!"

dialogues.jp:
風は、だんだんと強くなり、大きな声を出さな
いと聞こえないほどだった。
dialogues.en:
The wind was gradually getting stronger, to the point where
I couldn't be heard unless I shouted.
dialogues.text:
The wind was gradually getting stronger, to the point where
I couldn't be heard unless I shouted.

dialogues.jp: 「帰らないと、雨が強くなるぞ！」
dialogues.en:
"The rain is only going to get stronger! You have to go
home!"
dialogues.text:
"The rain is only going to get stronger! You have to go
home!"

dialogues.jp: 月城がぶんぶんと首を振る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro firmly shook her head.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro firmly shook her head.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……花を、守らなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "...I have to protect the flower."
dialogues.text: "...I have to protect the flower."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……花をって」
dialogues.en: "...The flower..."
dialogues.text: "...The flower..."

dialogues.jp:
ぽつぽつ、だったものが、バラ、バラ、になっ
ていく。落ちてくる雨粒は、すぐに激しいもの
へと変わっていった。
dialogues.en:
Drip drip, soon became pitterpatter. The drizzle had turned
into a furious downpour before we knew it."
dialogues.text:
Drip drip, soon became pitterpatter. The drizzle had turned
into a furious downpour before we knew it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……花を、守らなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "...I have toprotect the flower..."
dialogues.text: "...I have toprotect the flower..."

dialogues.jp:
強風に煽られた横殴りの雨が容赦なく体を打ち
付けてくる。
dialogues.en:
The strong winds only served to make the rain more fierce,
unwaveringly striking out bodies.
dialogues.text:
The strong winds only served to make the rain more fierce,
unwaveringly striking out bodies.

dialogues.jp: 「早く、帰ろう！」
dialogues.en: "You need to hurry home, now!"
dialogues.text: "You need to hurry home, now!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...I can't."
dialogues.text: "...I can't."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「でも、このままじゃ、月城が……」
dialogues.en: "But at this rate, you'd..."
dialogues.text: "But at this rate, you'd..."

dialogues.jp:
さらに雨が｛ひど／酷｝くなっていく。たくさんの雨粒が
地面を一瞬にして、泥だらけにしていく。
dialogues.en:
The continued to get fiercer. The constant rain was quickly
turning the soil into mud.
dialogues.text:
The continued to get fiercer. The constant rain was quickly
turning the soil into mud.

dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro...!"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro...!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ダメ、花を、守らなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "...I can't, I must protect the flower..."
dialogues.text: "...I can't, I must protect the flower..."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ロスキルラベンダーに覆い被さるよう
にして風雨から守ろうとする。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was using a bucket to cover the Roskill Lavender
as best as she could.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was using a bucket to cover the Roskill Lavender
as best as she could.

dialogues.jp:
服は濡れ、泥に汚れ、髪も身体もぐしょぐしょ
になっていた。
dialogues.en:
Her clothes were drenched, and her entire body was dirtied
by the fresh mud.
dialogues.text:
Her clothes were drenched, and her entire body was dirtied
by the fresh mud.

dialogues.jp:
傘を開くが、ちゃんと持っていられないほど強
い風に煽られ、どうしようもない。
dialogues.en:
I quickly opened the umbrella, knowing that the wind wasn't
going to wait for anyone.
dialogues.text:
I quickly opened the umbrella, knowing that the wind wasn't
going to wait for anyone.

dialogues.jp:
「……どうして！　そこまでしなきゃいけない
　モノじゃないだろ！」
dialogues.en: "...Why are you risking your life for this plant? Why!?"
dialogues.text: "...Why are you risking your life for this plant? Why!?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……大切なの！」
dialogues.en: "...It's special!"
dialogues.text: "...It's special!"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「こんなところにいたら、肺炎になるぞ！」
dialogues.en: "You'd catch pneumonia if you stay here!"
dialogues.text: "You'd catch pneumonia if you stay here!"

dialogues.jp:
冷たい雨は容赦なく俺達の身体を打ち付け、体
温を奪っていった。
dialogues.en:
The cold rain poured into us with no mercy, soaking us to
the skin.
dialogues.text:
The cold rain poured into us with no mercy, soaking us to
the skin.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、風上に立ち、風雨から月城を守る。
dialogues.en:
I stood in the direction of the wind, protecting Tsukishiro
from the wind and rain.
dialogues.text:
I stood in the direction of the wind, protecting Tsukishiro
from the wind and rain.

dialogues.jp:
「……これで少しは大丈夫だろ。こうなったら、
　俺も付き合うから」
dialogues.en:
"...This should work for a short while. If you're staying, I
am too."
dialogues.text:
"...This should work for a short while. If you're staying, I
am too."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai..."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai..."

dialogues.jp: ──ビュウウ！
dialogues.en: ──*Whoosh!*
dialogues.text: ──*Whoosh!*

dialogues.jp:
そう言った矢先に、強い風が吹いて傘が飛ばさ
れる。
dialogues.en:
Just when I said that, a sudden wind blew the umbrella right
off my fingers.
dialogues.text:
Just when I said that, a sudden wind blew the umbrella right
off my fingers.

dialogues.jp:
後ろにいた月城も、その風に飛ばされ、地面に
突っ伏す。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro, just behind me, was thrown to the floor.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro, just behind me, was thrown to the floor.

dialogues.jp: 「月城！」
dialogues.en: "Tskushiro!!"
dialogues.text: "Tskushiro!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、月城を抱き起こす。
dialogues.en: I quickly helped her up.
dialogues.text: I quickly helped her up.

dialogues.jp:
服は、見るも無惨に泥まみれになり、こんな時
でさえ持っている人形は、雨と泥にやられ、半
ば壊れかけていた。
dialogues.en:
Her clothes were practically beyond repair. The doll she
always carried with her, was half destroyed from the mud and
rain.
dialogues.text:
Her clothes were practically beyond repair. The doll she
always carried with her, was half destroyed from the mud and
rain.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...The flower!"
dialogues.text: "...The flower!"

dialogues.jp:
それでも月城は、千切れそうなくらい風に煽ら
れている、ロスキルラベンダーの心配をしてい
た。
dialogues.en:
Yet even then, the only thing Tsukishiro could think about,
was the Roskill Lavender.
dialogues.text:
Yet even then, the only thing Tsukishiro could think about,
was the Roskill Lavender.

dialogues.jp:
彼女の小さな身体はすっかり冷え切っていたが、
どうしても、動こうとはしなかった。
dialogues.en:
But her fragile body, chilled to it's very core, could
barely move.
dialogues.text:
But her fragile body, chilled to it's very core, could
barely move.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、転がっていたバケツで、草を覆ってい
たが、結局飛ばされてしまう。
dialogues.en:
She tried to roll over and cover the Roskill Lavender with
the bucket again, but the wind blew it out of her hands
easily.
dialogues.text:
She tried to roll over and cover the Roskill Lavender with
the bucket again, but the wind blew it out of her hands
easily.

dialogues.jp:
雨は、一向に弱まる気配を見せず、ただただ、
俺達を絶望の淵にたたき落とすためだけだと思
われるくらい強く降り続けた。
dialogues.en:
The rain, showing no signs of letting up at all, continued
to drench us in a torrent of despair.
dialogues.text:
The rain, showing no signs of letting up at all, continued
to drench us in a torrent of despair.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……花を、守らなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "..I have to protect... the flower...!"
dialogues.text: "..I have to protect... the flower...!"

dialogues.jp:
しかし、もともと強いわけではなかったロスキ
ルラベンダーは、風と雨により、葉を失い、茎
も折れているようだった。
dialogues.en:
But the Roskill Lavender could no longer struggle against
the overpowering wind and rain, and it's leaves were blown
away, it's stalk broken.
dialogues.text:
But the Roskill Lavender could no longer struggle against
the overpowering wind and rain, and it's leaves were blown
away, it's stalk broken.

dialogues.jp: 「そんな……」
dialogues.en: "Oh no..."
dialogues.text: "Oh no..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...The flower..."
dialogues.text: "...The flower..."

dialogues.jp:
ロスキルラベンダーに、もう望みがないのは、
誰の目にも明かだった。
dialogues.en:
There was no hope left for it. There was no denying that
now.
dialogues.text:
There was no hope left for it. There was no denying that
now.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、雨とも涙ともつかない、水のスジで顔
中を濡らし、悲痛な目で俺を見た。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, with a combination of rain and tears dripping
down her face, turned to me with incredibly sad eyes.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, with a combination of rain and tears dripping
down her face, turned to me with incredibly sad eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ここまで、育てたのに」
dialogues.en: "...I raised it for so long..."
dialogues.text: "...I raised it for so long..."

dialogues.jp: 風に煽られ、月城の身体がよろめく。
dialogues.en: Another strong wind blew, unbalanacing Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: Another strong wind blew, unbalanacing Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……花が咲くと、思ってたのに」
dialogues.en: "...I really thought a flower would bloom."
dialogues.text: "...I really thought a flower would bloom."

dialogues.jp: びしゃあ、と音を立てて、地面に倒れる月城。
dialogues.en: With those last words, she collapsed onto the floor.
dialogues.text: With those last words, she collapsed onto the floor.

dialogues.jp: 彼女は、そのまま気を失ってしまった。
dialogues.en: She lost consciousness shortly after.
dialogues.text: She lost consciousness shortly after.

dialogues.jp: 「月城！　月城！」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro! Tsukishiro!!"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro! Tsukishiro!!"

dialogues.jp:
何度呼んでも、月城は、ただ雨に打たれ続ける
だけで、返事をすることはなかった。
dialogues.en:
No matter how many times I called out, the only reply came
from the continous downpour.
dialogues.text:
No matter how many times I called out, the only reply came
from the continous downpour.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その傍らには、泥水で汚れ手足の千切
れかけた人形──ピロスが見る影もなく風雨に
晒されていた。
dialogues.en:
And the punishing wind and rain had cut up that doll--Piros,
and left him broken beyond repair.
dialogues.text:
And the punishing wind and rain had cut up that doll--Piros,
and left him broken beyond repair.

dialogues.en: "Damnit...!"
dialogues.text: "Damnit...!"

dialogues.jp: 「なんで……、なんで……」
dialogues.en: "Why... why..."
dialogues.text: "Why... why..."

dialogues.jp:
花を咲かせるどころか、ロスキルラベンダーは
その命すらも、失っていた。
dialogues.en:
The flower that was supposed to bloom, the Roskill Lavender,
was lost.
dialogues.text:
The flower that was supposed to bloom, the Roskill Lavender,
was lost.

dialogues.jp:
あそこまで育っていたのが奇跡だったその草は
雨が止んだ後に、再び立ち直るとは、到底思え
なかった。
dialogues.en:
The miracle was killed by the rain. It couldn't possibly
recover from this.
dialogues.text:
The miracle was killed by the rain. It couldn't possibly
recover from this.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、小さな月城を抱きかかえながら、空に広
がる雲を恨んだ。
dialogues.en:
Holding the unconscious Tsukishiro close to me, protecting
her from the elements, I looked up at the sky in despair.
dialogues.text:
Holding the unconscious Tsukishiro close to me, protecting
her from the elements, I looked up at the sky in despair.

dialogues.jp: そして、
dialogues.en: And,
dialogues.text: And,

dialogues.jp: 「ちくしょう！　なんでなんだよおッ！」
dialogues.en: "Goddamnit, Why! Why did this have to happen???!!!"
dialogues.text: "Goddamnit, Why! Why did this have to happen???!!!"

dialogues.jp:
と叫んだが、吹き荒れる風に、すべてかき消さ
れてしまった。
dialogues.en:
My shouts, all that I had left to give, were drowned out by
the wind, leaving nothing behind.
dialogues.text:
My shouts, all that I had left to give, were drowned out by
the wind, leaving nothing behind.

dialogues.jp: ◆嵐の夜◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Night of the Storm◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Night of the Storm◆

dialogues.jp:
空模様が怪しい夜、俺はイヤな予感がして、学
校へ向かった。
dialogues.en:
With the sky looking gloomy, I got a bad feeling, and headed
to school.
dialogues.text:
With the sky looking gloomy, I got a bad feeling, and headed
to school.

dialogues.jp: 風は強くなり、嵐になるのは必至だった。
dialogues.en: The wind got stronger and stronger, growing into a storm.
dialogues.text: The wind got stronger and stronger, growing into a storm.

dialogues.jp:
予感は的中し、体育館裏には、月城がロスキル
ラベンダーを一生懸命守ろうとしていた。
dialogues.en:
Just as I had thought, behind the gym, Tsukishiro was
protecting the Roskill Lavender with her very life.
dialogues.text:
Just as I had thought, behind the gym, Tsukishiro was
protecting the Roskill Lavender with her very life.

dialogues.jp:
天候は嵐に変わり、俺は月城に帰ろうと言った
が、彼女は、がんとしてその場を動こうとしな
かった。
dialogues.en:
With the weather getting even worse, I pleaded with her to
go home, but she would not budge.
dialogues.text:
With the weather getting even worse, I pleaded with her to
go home, but she would not budge.

dialogues.jp:
仕方なく、俺は、月城とロスキルラベンダーを
守ろうとしたのだが、激しすぎる嵐に、俺達は
飛ばされ、草も飛ばされてしまった。
dialogues.en:
There was nothing else I could do, so I stayed with
Tsukishiro to protect the plant. But a sudden, violent wind
blew both us and the Roskill Lavender away.
dialogues.text:
There was nothing else I could do, so I stayed with
Tsukishiro to protect the plant. But a sudden, violent wind
blew both us and the Roskill Lavender away.

dialogues.jp:
月城が一生懸命育てていたロスキルラベンダー
は、たった１度の嵐によって、希望もろとも根
こそぎ奪っていったのだった……。
dialogues.en:
The plant she had put all her hopes into, the Roskill
Lavender, lost in just 1 single frantic struggle during a
storm...
dialogues.text:
The plant she had put all her hopes into, the Roskill
Lavender, lost in just 1 single frantic struggle during a
storm...
